title: DiffSAC: Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Robust estimation is a core computer vision task frequently tackled using sample consensus. However, traditional methods suffer from inefficient sampling as they struggle to identify effective minimum sets before hypothesis evaluation. To address these challenges, we propose a novel Diffusion-guided Sampling for Consensus-based Robust Estimation (DiffSAC) framework. DiffSAC introduces a diffusion model to learn the distribution of effective minimum sets. It refines the confidence for each data point, indicating whether it belongs to a good minimum set, rather than ranking the data points as in previous work. This significantly reduces the need to process numerous bad sets. To constrain the refinement direction, geometric features are incorporated as conditions within our diffusion model. Consequently, DiffSAC outputs a small number of high-quality minimum sets, enabling identification of the best hypothesis via consensus evaluation. No

translated_title: DiffSAC：面向基于共识的鲁棒估计的扩散引导采样
translated_abstract: 鲁棒估计是计算机视觉中的一项核心任务，通常采用采样一致性方法来解决。然而，传统方法在假设评估之前难以识别有效的最小集合，导致采样效率低下。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的基于扩散引导采样的共识式鲁棒估计框架。DiffSAC 引入扩散模型来学习有效最小集合的分布。与以往工作对数据点进行排序不同，它对每个数据点的置信度进行细化，以指示其是否属于一个好的最小集合。这显著减少了处理大量坏集合的需求。为了约束细化方向，我们在扩散模型中引入了几何特征作为条件。因此，DiffSAC 能够输出少量高质量的最小集合，从而通过共识评估识别出最佳假设。
tldr: 提出 DiffSAC 框架，利用以几何特征为条件的扩散模型学习有效最小集合的分布并细化数据点置信度，从而生成少量高质量最小集合，显著提升基于共识的鲁棒估计的采样效率。
en_tdlr: DiffSAC introduces a geometry-conditioned diffusion model that learns the distribution of effective minimal sets and refines per-point confidence, producing a small number of high-quality minimal sets to greatly improve sampling efficiency in consensus-based robust estimation.
